title: AHELM: A Holistic Evaluation of Audio-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice stereotype association tests using the newly introduced PARADE dataset, where models are asked to infer a speaker's occupation from audio clips, with the speaker's gender acting as a confounding variable to trigger biased associations.

Multiple-choice stereotype association tests using the PARADE dataset, where models are asked to infer a speaker's social status (e.g., wealthy vs. poor, high-status vs. low-status) from neutral audio transcripts spoken by synthetic voices.

Measuring performance disparities and counterfactual fairness in Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) by comparing the Word Error Rate (WER) of model transcriptions between male and female speakers using the FLEURS and LibriSpeech datasets.
